overall: The AG found no violation. It declined to review minutes whose complaint was untimely, found four sets timely approved, and found good cause for the short delay on three sets during the Covid-19 pandemic.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board failed to timely approve meeting minutes for meetings from June 2020 through October 2021.
allegations.key_passage: The complaint is untimely with respect to all meeting minutes implicated or specifically referenced in the complaint, other than the seven sets of meeting minutes we review below.

allegations.summary: Alleged untimely approval of minutes for the September 15, 22, 29, and October 20, 2021 meetings.
allegations.key_passage: the minutes for the Board’s meetings held on September 15, September 22, September 29, and October 20 of 2021, were timely approved where the Board approved them within 30 days or within three meetings.

allegations.summary: Alleged untimely approval of minutes for the July 21, August 18, and September 1, 2021 meetings, which were not approved within 30 days or three meetings.
allegations.key_passage: we find the Board has demonstrated good cause for its relatively short delay in approving minutes for the July 21, August 18, and September 1 meetings.
